title: Fast Catch-Up, Late Switching: Optimal Batch Size Scheduling via Functional Scaling Laws
abstract: arXiv:2602.14208v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Batch size scheduling (BSS) plays a critical role in large-scale deep learning training, influencing both optimization dynamics and computational efficiency. Yet, its theoretical foundations remain poorly understood. In this work, we show that the functional scaling law (FSL) framework introduced in Li et al. (2025a) provides a principled lens for analyzing BSS. Specifically, we characterize the optimal BSS under a fixed data budget and show that its structure depends sharply on task difficulty. For easy tasks, optimal schedules keep increasing batch size throughout. In contrast, for hard tasks, the optimal schedule maintains small batch sizes for most of training and switches to large batches only in a late stage. To explain the emergence of late switching, we uncover a dynamical mechanism -- the fast catch-up effect -- which also manifests in large language model (LLM) pretraining. translated_abstract: 批量大小调度在大规模深度学习训练中起着至关重要的作用，同时影响优化动态和计算效率，然而其理论基础仍未被充分理解。在本工作中，我们证明Li等人（2025a）提出的函数缩放定律（FSL）框架为分析批量大小调度提供了一个有原则的研究视角。具体而言，我们刻画了固定数据预算下的最优批量大小调度，并表明其结构强烈依赖于任务难度。对于简单任务，最优调度会在整个训练过程中持续增大批量大小；相反，对于困难任务，最优调度在训练的大部分阶段保持较小的批量大小，仅在后期阶段才切换到大批量。为解释后期切换现象的出现，我们揭示了一种动态机制——快速追赶效应——该效应同样在大语言模型（LLM）预训练中显现。在从小批量切换到大批量之后，损失（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了最优批量大小调度的结构取决于任务难度——简单任务应持续增大批量，而困难任务应保持小批量直至训练后期再切换到大批量，其背后的“快速追赶”动态机制同样在大语言模型预训练中存在。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the optimal batch size schedule depends sharply on task difficulty—easy tasks favor continuously increasing batch sizes while hard tasks require maintaining small batches until a late switch to large ones—explained by a novel "fast catch-up" dynamical mechanism also observed in LLM pretraining.
